recursive.description: If true, enables recursive extraction of nested archives (`-r`).

one_entry.description: Controls handling of archives containing only one entry: 'inside', 'rename', or 'here'. Maps to `--one <mode>`.

overwrite.description: If true, allows overwriting existing output directory (`-o`).

flat.description: If true, extracts contents directly into current directory (`-f`).

list.description: If true, lists archive contents instead of extracting (`-l`).

metadata.description: If true, extracts metadata from .deb/.gem archives instead of contents (`-m`).

quiet.description: Number of times to suppress warnings: 0=normal, 1=suppress warnings, 2=silent. Maps to `-q` repetitions.

verbose.description: Number of times to increase verbosity: 1=show filenames, 2=debug info. Maps to `-v` repetitions.
